name: Cipanas Palace
scope: Standing main building at Cipanas Presidential Palace, including the public-facing stepped verandah, one-storey central and side ranges, and rear veranda.
era: Standing Gedung Induk in its current public exterior configuration.

originalReview.notes: Rijksmuseum labels this exact scan of a c.1844–46 chalk drawing public domain. At full size the central villa has an elevated formal front and broad eaves. Used only the coarse proportions and setting, with standing geometry and the current owner’s written records controlling the model.

review.notes: Started from the original Qualla story inventory. The Rappard lithograph and other archive scans carry attribution licenses. The two ostensibly public-domain modern images have uncredited authors and no verifiable original item at the linked agency source. Used the verified public-domain Rijksmuseum original and written primary records.
